sources: UK DESNZ/DEFRA GHG Conversion Factors (average petrol car ~0.17 kg CO2e/km, rail/metro ~0.035 kg CO2e/pkm)
India GHG Program (WRI India, CII, TERI) India-Specific Road Transport Emission Factors (car 0.10-0.26 kg CO2/vkm, two-wheeler 0.03-0.06 kg CO2/vkm, intracity bus 0.015-0.07 kg CO2/pkm)
_meta.notes: Central values align with DEFRA / golden oracle benchmarks; mode ranges reflect real fleet variance across Indian and international passenger occupancy.

car.source: DEFRA average petrol car (~0.17) / India GHG Program petrol car range adjusted for ~1.2 occupancy

two_wheeler.source: Starter commuter benchmark (upper bound) / India GHG Program 100-300cc fleet lower bound

auto.source: CNG three-wheeler per passenger-km assumption with 1-1.5 occupancy

bus.source: DEFRA / India GHG Program intracity bus range (occupancy dependent)

metro.source: DEFRA light rail/metro (~0.035) / CEA grid-weighted metro range

idling.source: Assumption + range (natural fuel-burn proxy; local PM/NOx also cut, never estimated as unverified grams)
